breakpoints.note: sc_asn1_decode_choice begins parsing the attacker-controlled ASN.1 buffer as a PrKDF entry.

Attacker-controlled ASN.1 data from the fuzzer buffer is parsed. sc_asn1_decode_choice partially decodes the input and may internally allocate memory (via SC_ASN1_ALLOC) for info.subject.value before encountering an error and returning r < 0.

sc_format_asn1_entry stores &info.subject.value (the address of the stack-local pointer field) into asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm. The error handler later uses parm as the argument to free, but parm is a pointer-to-pointer (stack address), not the heap pointer itself.

free() is called with asn1_com_prkey_attr[0].parm, which equals &info.subject.value — a stack address at offset 360 within the info local variable. ASAN detects this as a bad-free because the address was never malloc'd.
